lyrics:
Lyrics by Kay Uwe Rott: THE FRIENDS WILL FIND THEIR WAY HOME We left with nothing but a song inside our hearts, and roads beneath our feet that we had never walked before. We followed distant lights, we crossed the years and seasons, we lost ourselves sometimes and found another way. There were nights without a moon, there were days without an answer, and places we remembered only because they disappeared. But somewhere in the distance there was always something calling. Not a voice. Not a name. Just a feeling that we were not finished yet. So we kept on walking. We kept on searching. We kept on dreaming. And maybe home was never waiting at the end of the road. Maybe home was with us all along. We will find our way home, wherever the road may lead. We will find our way home, through every distance, every dream. And if we lose the stars tonight, we'll follow where the echoes roam. We may wander far apart — but the friends will find their way home. Some found love. Some found silence. Some found another sky. Some carried memories of people they could never say goodbye to. And some discovered that a heart can have more than one home. The years may change us. The world may turn. The roads may disappear. But the light we carried when we first began is still burning somewhere. So if you are walking under a different sky, if you are searching for a place you cannot name, don't be afraid of the distance. Keep walking. Keep looking. Keep listening. Because somewhere beyond the horizon, another friend may be walking too. And one day, perhaps without knowing when, our roads will meet again. We will find our way home. Not because the road was easy. Not because we never lost our way. But because, after all these years, we never stopped looking for the light. And when we finally meet, we may discover that home was never a place. It was the moment we found each other.
